title: Helm Pink
mood: wounded and pleading, with a sting at the end
subject: seeing his girlfriend at a red light on the back of another man's motorbike, wearing the pink helmet he bought her
caption: Pop Melayu band in the late-2000s Indonesian style. A clean-to-crunch electric lead guitar playing Melayu-ornamented fills with grace-note turns and slides between vocal lines, acoustic guitar strumming steady eighths underneath, a keyboard string pad, a bamboo suling answering the chorus, a plain rock bass, and a simple four-four pop-rock kit with tom fills. Late-2000s radio band sound in a medium room, the lead guitar and voice forward, the suling slightly back. Male nasal high tenor with Melayu cengkok: ornamented turns and vibrato on held vowel endings, plaintive and pleading. 84 BPM, A minor. Wounded and pleading, with a sting at the end. No dangdut koplo kendang, no EDM, no autotune, no rap, no trap drums.
lyrics:
[Intro - suling melody over acoustic strum, lead guitar turn]

[Verse 1]
Lampu merah perempatan dekat pasar
Motor hitam berhenti tepat di sebelahku
Yang dibonceng pakai helm warna pink
Helm yang aku beli waktu kamu ulang tahun

[Pre-Chorus]
Kamu bilang malam ini di rumah aja
Kamu bilang kepalamu pusing

[Chorus]
Helm pink itu dari aku
Masih ada stiker namamu di belakangnya
Kamu peluk dia erat-erat
Kayak dulu kamu peluk aku

[Verse 2]
Lampu hijau, kalian jalan duluan
Aku diam, klakson di belakang ramai
HP-ku bunyi, pesan dari kamu
"Sayang, aku udah mau tidur, ya"

[Chorus]
Helm pink itu dari aku
Masih ada stiker namamu di belakangnya
Kamu bohong sambil dibonceng dia
Dan aku yang bayar helmnya

[Outro - lead guitar Melayu turn, suling fades]
Besok helmnya balikin, ya
Dia bisa beli sendiri
